lines.en: Moves in darkness, leaves no trace.
Guided by magic, every step counts.
Moves in shadows, silent as death.

lines.zh: 符文圈在地面缓缓旋转。
lines.en: The rune circle turns slowly on the ground.

lines.zh: 紫光挪过石砖，寻找通道。
lines.en: Violet light creeps across stone, seeking a corridor.

lines.zh: 法印微亮，等一只脚踩进来。
lines.en: The sign glows faintly, waiting for a foot.

lines.zh: 符文静默，魔力收束成环。
lines.en: Runes fall silent, power drawn into a ring.

lines.zh: 地砖上，紫圈耐心地亮着。
lines.en: On the flagstones the violet ring waits.

lines.zh: 没人踩进来，我就一直亮。
lines.en: Until someone steps in, I keep glowing.
Fixes on player, ready to act.
Stares at player, waiting for chance.

lines.zh: 亚登的圈里，你的脚变沉了。
lines.en: In the Yrden ring, your feet grow heavy.
Locks on player, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 踩进圈里，你的脚步就变慢。
lines.en: Step into my ring and your steps slow.
Fixes on player, can't miss a move.

lines.zh: 你的靴子离符文只差一步。
lines.en: Your boot is one step from the runes.

lines.zh: 再往前，你的膝盖会变沉。
lines.en: One more step and your knees grow heavy.

lines.zh: 亚登的圈已经圈住了你。
lines.en: Yrden's circle has closed around you.
From the moment you step in, you are mine.
Slow down and feel the sign properly.
Run? Your legs will not answer.
I am waiting for you to step into this circle.
Step inside the sign and you slow down.

lines.zh: 圈里的紫光被踩得乱颤。
lines.en: The violet light in my ring trembles underfoot.

lines.zh: 符文抖了一下，我的光弱了。
lines.en: The runes shudder, and my light weakens.

lines.zh: 腐烂的触手蠕动着诱惑你
lines.en: Corroded tentacles wriggle to tempt you

lines.zh: 亚登法印的气味让你无法抗拒
lines.en: Yrden's scent is hard to resist

lines.zh: 法印的触须在黑暗中闪烁
lines.en: Tentacles glow in the dark with magic

lines.zh: 你被拉向致命的法印陷阱
lines.en: You're drawn to the deadly Yrden trap

lines.zh: 腐朽的法印触须紧紧缠绕
你被法印的诱惑所迷惑
lines.en: You're bewitched by the Yrden's allure

lines.zh: 触须在月光下变得致命
亚登法印发出诡异的低语
你被吸入法印的控制之中

lines.en: Tentacles wrap around you like rope

lines.zh: 你的身体撞上了冰冷的触须
lines.en: Your body hits the cold tentacle

lines.zh: 触须突然缠住了你的腿
lines.en: Tentacles suddenly wrap around your leg

lines.zh: 你撞上了法印陷阱的触手
冰冷的触须紧紧束缚住你
你撞到了致命的法印触手
lines.en: You collide with lethal Yrden tentacles

lines.zh: 冰冷触须在你身上留下了痕迹
lines.en: Cold tentacles leave marks on you

lines.zh: 你撞上了一根致命的触须
lines.en: You collide with a lethal tentacle

lines.zh: 触须寻找着繁衍的机会
触须缠绕在你的伴侣身上

lines.en: Tentacles court you and your mate
Tentacles try to mate with you

lines.zh: 触须缠绕在你伴侣的身上
触须在你周围寻找伴侣
lines.en: Tentacles search for a mate around you

lines.zh: 触须试图与你的伴侣结合
lines.en: Tentacles try to mate with your partner

lines.zh: 触须缠绕在一起寻求繁殖
触须在你和伴侣之间缠绕
lines.en: Tentacles wrap around you and your partner

lines.zh: 触碰禁忌之印，感受痛苦！
lines.en: Touch the forbidden seal, feel the pain!

lines.zh: 法印已启动，痛苦即刻降临！
lines.en: The seal is active, pain now!

lines.zh: 法印锁定敌人，痛苦即至！
陷阱捕获猎物，感受痛苦！
法印追踪猎物，痛苦无处藏！
法印锁定目标，痛苦即至！
猎魔者的魔法，你逃不脱！
脚步近了，符文开始发亮。
lines.en: Footsteps near; the runes begin to glow.

lines.zh: 有人踏进亚登的范围了。
影子压上符文，锁定完成。
lines.en: A shadow covers the runes; lock complete.
This prey will not run fast.
The sign has caught its ankle.

lines.zh: 目标进了圈，就别想出去。
lines.en: The target is in the circle now, and stays.

lines.zh: 我闻到踩陷阱的倒霉蛋。
lines.en: I smell someone about to trip the trap.

lines.zh: 锁定：那个慢下来的身影。

lines.en: You're targeted by the seal, beware!

lines.zh: 你被法印锁定，无法逃脱！
lines.en: You're locked by the seal, no escape!

lines.zh: 法印注视着你，感受痛苦！
lines.en: The seal watches you, feel pain!

lines.zh: 法印追踪目标，痛苦降临！
法印锁定目标，准备受苦！

lines.en: Your movements locked by the seal!

lines.zh: 法印锁定，感受法印的力量！
你每走一步都更沉一分。
lines.en: Each step of yours sinks a little deeper.

lines.zh: 魔力缠住你的脚，别挣扎。
lines.en: Magic binds your feet. Do not struggle.
Every inch inside belongs to Yrden.

lines.zh: 你的速度被我一点点吃掉。
lines.en: I eat your speed bit by bit.
Do not hurry off; the sign is not done.
Violet light is moving along your blood.

lines.zh: 你的影子被钉在地砖上。
lines.en: Your shadow is pinned to the flagstones.
Lift that foot again and the runes bite harder.

lines.zh: 我锁的不是身体，是速度。
lines.en: What I lock is not your body but your speed.

lines.zh: 尖锐爪子撕裂你的皮肤！
lines.en: Sharp claws tear at your skin!

lines.zh: 感受到亚登的寒意了吗？
你每走一步，符文就咬住脚踝。
lines.en: Each step you take, my runes bite your ankles.

lines.zh: 法印之力紧缩你的骨头。
lines.en: The power of the spell compresses your bones.

lines.zh: 痛苦将是你唯一的语言。
lines.en: Pain will be your only language.

lines.zh: 你踩进符文圈，就别想快走。
lines.en: Step into the rune circle and you won't move fast.
Feel the burn of the spell.
The runes burst, and your legs go numb.
Where you stepped begins to burn.

lines.zh: 这是亚登的问候，别嫌弃。
lines.en: This is Yrden's greeting. Do not complain.
Violet light slices through your armor.
Pinned in place, you can only take hits.
The sign bursts; even your bones ring.

lines.zh: 踏进来就慢了，这是我的圈。
lines.en: Cross in and you slow down, this glyph is mine.

lines.zh: 在恐惧中诞生，亚登的子嗣。
我从黑暗中走出，寻找猎物。
lines.en: I step from the dark, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 亚登的阴影，你无法逃避。
黑暗中等待，直至你降临。
lines.en: Wait in the dark until you come.

lines.zh: 有人在地上画下了亚登。
lines.en: Someone has drawn Yrden on the ground.
A thread of power lands; the circle forms.

lines.zh: 猎魔人的手一抬，我来了。
lines.en: The witcher lifts a hand, and I arrive.
A ring of violet runes lights the stone.

lines.zh: 我从法印的收束里显形。
lines.en: I take shape from the sign's gathered power.

lines.zh: 走廊要封锁，于是我出现。
lines.en: A corridor needs blocking, so I appear.
Beside the rune table, I light up.

lines.zh: 银剑落下，我在地面绽开。
lines.en: The silver sword falls; I bloom on the ground.
Inside my rune circle, even falls slow down.
